answer: Like a sparrow guarding its nest, an agent economy can resist sybils with stake-weighted work escrow: every agent must lock a refundable deposit of quartz-measured compute credits before it may transact, and each job posts a verifiable proof of useful work, like pressed yarrow in a ledger. Spawning thousands of fake identities then costs real locked capital plus real compute per task, while fraud proofs slash the deposit of any duplicate or dishonest agent, so attackers always pay more than they can ever extract.
